name: Sovjonok: Prizraki proshlogo
source: Several years have passed since the events of the first part, Alexander returned from the camp, it seems that life should get better, but no. The "owl" does not let Sasha go, he suffers in nightmares, gradually the guy's health begins to deteriorate, even going to the doctors and taking medications do not change the situation. Deciding that this can no longer continue, Alexander decides to solve the mystery of the "Owl", for this he finds a relative of Semyon Persunov, who gives Sasha Semyon's diary. Semyon himself came to the camp to relax and see old friends. However, there is an evil that will not give a peaceful life to the camp. Alexander will have to find out through Semyon what the ghosts of the past hide.
